title: The Blue Phone
note: b385 — first use of 'phone'. P5's 'two panels' is drawn as one combined picture with two phone instances side by side rather than a literal divided panel, the same approach used elsewhere in this batch. P7's phone screen reuses the 'child' prop (added b384) scaled down inside the phone's own screen pane.

pages.brief: Nell the bee hovering over an old blue mobile phone lying in long grass, dew on the screen. Front legs behind her back like a detective. Green and blue palette.
pages.alt: Nell the bee hovers over an old blue mobile phone lying in long grass, dew on the screen, front legs tucked behind her back like a detective.

pages.brief: Pip landed beside the phone, head tilted right over sideways to look at it. Nell shrugging mid-air. Both baffled. Close, funny, character-driven.
pages.alt: Pip lands beside the phone, head tilted right over to look at it, while Nell shrugs mid-air — both of them completely baffled.

pages.brief: Olive the owl in full lecturing mode, one wing raised, standing over the phone. Her round shape and firm expression fill the frame. Pip and Nell listening in total faith.
pages.alt: Olive the owl stands over the phone in full lecturing mode, one wing raised, her round shape filling the frame, while Pip and Nell listen in total faith.

pages.brief: Nell hovering with the phone held up to where her ear would be, eyes shut, listening hard. Olive in the background, put out. One page, two opinions.
pages.alt: Nell hovers with the phone held up to where her ear would be, eyes shut, listening hard, while Olive looks on from the background, put out.

pages.brief: Two panels: Olive's foot filling a blurry phone screen; Nell talking earnestly into a completely blank screen. Both absurd, both committed.
pages.alt: Two halves of the same picture: Olive's foot fills a blurry phone screen on the left, while Nell talks earnestly into a completely blank screen on the right — both absurd, both committed.

pages.brief: The moment of the ring: the phone lit up in the grass and all three characters caught airborne in different directions, feathers and legs everywhere. Big comic burst of movement.
pages.alt: The phone suddenly lights up and rings in the grass, sending all three friends flying off in different directions in a big comic burst of movement.

pages.brief: The phone screen shown large and clear, displaying a simple picture of a child grinning. The three of them crowded round it, small, looking in. Soft blue screen glow on their faces.
pages.alt: The phone screen shows a simple picture of a smiling child, the three friends crowded small round it looking in, a soft blue glow on their faces.

pages.brief: The blue phone back in the grass exactly where it started, seen from a little distance, three small friends walking away into the evening. Quiet, warm, satisfying.
pages.alt: The blue phone sits back in the grass exactly where it started, while the three small friends walk away together into the quiet evening.
